source.evidence: (R) Starter field band: 2 coins and 5 active-job XP per credited field kill. Local balance for the shipped level-1 actors (Hooligan Wolves, shamans, bixies, quest-gated Hooligans); below the W123 battle reference of 25 coins / 50 job XP for a three-enemy win. Not recovered 2014 reward data.

Free Realms wiki, Battles (final-era difficulty anchors 1/3/5/9/13) and the reviewed W102 Field Enemies note. The actor levels themselves are authored in field_enemies.json (shipped actors currently span levels 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13 and 14, plus four quest-gated Hooligans that default to level 1); the wiki does not publish per-kill coin or XP values.

(R) Highroad field band: 4 coins and 10 active-job XP per credited field kill, double the starter rate because the level-3 Highroad Hooligan carries 220 HP / 8 damage against the starter actors' 100 HP / 7 damage. Local balance, not recovered 2014 reward data.
Free Realms wiki, Highroad Hijinx (difficulty 2 recommends level 3) and the reviewed W102 Field Enemies note's final-era level policy; no historical per-kill payout was recovered.

(R) Level 5-8 field band: 7 coins and 15 active-job XP per credited field kill, about 1.75x the level-3 band. The two level-7 MID-H1/MID-H2 Hooligans (definition 930060) use this band; the two level-5 MID-F1/MID-F2 Hooligan Wolves pay the definition-3156 override instead. Local balance, not recovered 2014 reward data.

(R) Level 9-13 field band: 12 coins and 25 active-job XP per credited field kill, half the W123 battle win reference for a three-enemy fight. The two level-9 MID-T1/MID-T2 shamans (definition 930025) and the two level-10 MID-Q1/MID-Q2 Hooligans (definition 930053) use this band. Local balance, not recovered 2014 reward data.

(R) Level 14-20 field band: 18 coins and 35 active-job XP per credited field kill, above the level 9-13 band and below the W123 battle reference of 25 coins / 50 job XP for a three-enemy win. Added for the level-14 high Wilds shaman camp; levels 15-20 reserve the same rate for future high field actors. Local balance, not recovered 2014 reward data.

(R) Hooligan Wolf (definition 3156) stays on the starter 2 coins / 5 job XP rate at every level: three level-1 W102-F1 starter wolves, two level-5 MID-F1/MID-F2 wolves, and one level-11 and one level-12 high-band wolf. Local policy so the kind cannot be retuned into a faucet by a level edit; those wolves therefore pay 2/5, not their level band.
Resources/Models.txt row 2470: model 3284 = wolf_generic.adr; locale 5100200 = Hooligan Wolf. These prove the resource identity of the kind, not any 2014 payout.
